We're picking an on-call scheduling tool for our engineering team of 40 people, and we need single sign-on. Please read the pricing pages for Rotamere, Wakespan and Vigilark:

https://rotamere.example/pricing
https://wakespan.example/pricing
https://vigilark.example/pricing

Write notes/pricing.md with each vendor's plans, the price per seat per month on yearly billing (and on monthly billing where they show it), any seat minimums, and which plan includes single sign-on and what it costs. Then work out what 40 seats with single sign-on would cost for a year on yearly billing at each vendor, and recommend the cheapest. Stick to what the pages say.

# On-call scheduling pricing comparison

Prices below are per seat per month in USD, as listed on each vendor's pricing page. Yearly/annual prices are billed for the year; taxes are excluded or may apply as stated by vendors. Calculations assume the stated 40 seats are paid seats and use yearly billing.

## Rotamere

| Plan | Yearly billing (per seat/month) | Monthly billing (per seat/month) | Seat minimum | Single sign-on |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| Free | $0 (up to 5 users) | Not stated | Up to 5 users | No SSO listed |
| Team | $19 | $23 | Not stated | No SSO listed |
| Business | $36 | $43 | 10 users | Includes SAML SSO (and SCIM) |
| Enterprise | Talk to sales | Not stated | Not stated | Includes everything in Business; price not stated |

**40 seats with SSO, yearly billing:** Business is the listed priced plan with SSO: 40 × $36 × 12 = **$17,280 per year**. Enterprise also includes SSO, but its price is not listed, so its cost cannot be calculated from the page.

## Wakespan

| Plan | Yearly billing (per seat/month) | Monthly billing (per seat/month) | Seat minimum | Single sign-on |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| Starter | $16 | $20 | Not stated | No SSO listed |
| Professional | $29 | $35 | Not stated | No SSO listed |
| Enterprise | $47 | Not offered (annual only) | 25 users | Includes SAML and OIDC SSO |

**40 seats with SSO, yearly billing:** Enterprise meets its 25-user minimum: 40 × $47 × 12 = **$22,560 per year**.

## Vigilark

| Plan | Yearly billing (per seat/month) | Monthly billing (per seat/month) | Seat minimum | Single sign-on |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| Basic | $11 | $14 | Any number | Not available/listed |
| Pro | $24 | $30 | 8 seats | SAML SSO add-on: $4 per seat per month, billed the same way as the plan |

**40 seats with SSO, yearly billing:** Pro plus the SSO add-on is $24 + $4 = $28 per seat per month. 40 × $28 × 12 = **$13,440 per year**.

## Recommendation

For 40 paid seats with single sign-on on yearly billing, **Vigilark Pro with the SSO add-on is the cheapest option among the calculable priced options, at $13,440 per year**. Rotamere Business is $17,280 per year; Wakespan Enterprise is $22,560 per year. Rotamere Enterprise also includes SSO, but the page says to talk to sales and provides no price, so it cannot be compared from the listed information.
